title: VSift transcript.get data v1
description: The data member of a complete transcript.get result: one bounded page of the segments that intersect [range.from_us, range.to_us), in start order. transcript_coverage (0.2.1) says which parts of the requested range a transcript covers, by the rule search uses: nothing read in an untranscribed range means nothing was transcribed there, not that nothing was said. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json: its coverage member is null, and its status complete, unless transcript_coverage.untranscribed_ranges is not empty, when coverage lists those ranges and the status is partial. Pass next_cursor back with the same session and range to continue; it is rejected for any other query, session or revision, or after the session expires.

transcript_coverage.description: The coverage of the whole requested range, the same on every page of one request, as search reports it: always present since 0.2.1, but not listed in required, because answers of the published 0.1.0 (kept valid against this schema by the compatibility test) have none.
